name: DBS Listening Studio
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: Separate speech, music and sound effects from a video or audio file with the released DnR v2 models (DBS-BSRNN, DBS-TIGER) and watch the predicted frequency boundaries of every inference window move with the content. Video keeps its picture; audio shows a clickable STFT spectrogram. The interface is available in English and Chinese.
Learning Where to Split: Dynamic Band Splitting for Audio Source Separation
